summary: Genmab A/S filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing Company Announcement No. 49, a Regulation (EU) 596/2014 Article 19 managers' transactions disclosure (the US-equivalent Form 4 insider-reporting mechanic). It reports board members Martin Schultz (617 shares) and Mijke Zachariasse (351 shares) each selling Genmab shares at DKK 3,540.87 on 2026-11-12 across Nasdaq Copenhagen and several European venues. No board recommendation, advisor, stake change, price offer or structural terms appear; this is ordinary insider sale reporting, not a special situation. No deal or event to watch.
